Third-party minimap mask asset
==============================

stream/circlemap.ytd is derived from the public FH4Map project:
https://github.com/kasuganosoras/fh4map

FH4Map is distributed under GNU GPL v3. A copy of GPL-3 is included in
third_party/GPL-3.txt.

NOVA uses this asset only as the streamed GTA V circular radar mask dictionary.
The NOVA HUD implementation and layout code are separate custom code.
